points: Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil with ½ tsp salt for the penne.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
steps.title: Get Prepped

points: When your pan of water is boiling, add the penne and bring back to the boil. Cook until tender, 12 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a colander and pop back in the pan. Drizzle with oil and stir through to stop it sticking together.
steps.title: Pasta Time

points: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the diced chicken and mushrooms and season with salt and pepper.
Fry until the chicken is golden brown on the outside and cooked through and the mushrooms have softened, 8-10 mins.
Once cooked, stir in the garlic and mixed herbs. Cook for 1 min more.

notes.text: Notice a stronger smell from your chicken? Don’t worry, this is normal due to packaging we use to keep it fresh.
Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw chicken and its packaging. It's cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Fry the Chicken

points: Stir the passata, red wine stock paste, sugar and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts) into the chicken.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat down and simmer until slightly thickened, 5-6 mins.
Once thickened, stir in the spinach a handful at a time until wilted and piping hot, 1-2 mins.
steps.title: Sauce Things Up

points: Once the spinach has wilted, stir through the creme fraiche and hard Italian style cheese.
Stir in the cooked pasta, then season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.title: Combine and Stir

points: When everything's ready, share the chicken pasta out between your serving bowls.
steps.title: Serve
